article.en: Dan Robinson has been worried all week.
article.zh: 丹·鲁滨逊整整一周都忧心忡忡。

article.en: Last Tuesday he received a letter from the local police.
article.zh: 上周二，他收到了当地警察局的一封信。

article.en: In the letter he was asked to call at the station.
article.zh: 信里请他到警察局去一趟。

article.en: Yesterday he went to the station and now he is not worried any more.
article.zh: 昨天他去了警察局，现在他不再担心了。

article.en: A smiling policeman told him that his bicycle had been found.
article.zh: 一位面带笑容的警察告诉他，他的自行车找到了。

article.en: Five days ago, someone picked up the bicycle in a small village four hundred miles away.
article.zh: 五天前，有人在四百英里外的一个小村子里捡到了那辆自行车。

article.en: The police are now sending it to his home by train.
article.zh: 警察现在正用火车把它运回家。

article.en: Dan was most surprised when he heard the news.
article.zh: 丹听到这个消息，非常吃惊。

article.en: He never expected the bicycle to be found.
article.zh: 他从没指望那辆自行车还能找到。

article.en: It was stolen twenty years ago when Dan was a boy of fifteen.
article.zh: 那辆车是二十年前丹十五岁时被偷走的。
